text:
meera: Quick update from infra — ForgeGate private cutover stalled. Customer reported that egress NAT never handed off, and airgap artifact sync failed on their appliance.

carlos: thanks. main blocker: their egress NAT uses a managed firewall that strips 4500/UDP for our healthprobes. They didn't include our health CIDR in the allow list.

linh: @carlos can you paste the exact CIDRs we need? I'll add to the onboarding doc and ping the customer.

carlos: it's 10.53.0.0/22 (internal probe range) and 172.16.33.128/27 for canary egress. also they need to allow outbound TCP 443 for artifact signing check.

meera: noted. ops action: @linh to update the runbook, @aj to coordinate with customer netops, @carlos to run a smoke once rules applied. I'll take deployment ownership for the canary.

aj: on it. Reaching out to ForgeGate netops now. ETA to confirmation ~ 2h. I'll drop status here.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/private-cutover (kb:deploy/forgegate/private)

sre-oncall: If they can't open 443 we can temporarily mirror artifacts to their airgapped registry — needs signed RPMs. Meera, do we have a signed bundle ready?

meera: we have one signed bundle in s3://artifacts/forgegate/2026-03-17. I can start a transfer if they request. Need ops approval for manual sync.

carlos: small test they can run once NAT rules applied:

```
curl -v --interface eth0 https://10.53.1.12:8080/healthz || echo "failed"
```

that checks internal probe path; also ask them to traceroute from their egress endpoint to 172.16.33.129.

linh: added CIDRs + test commands to the onboarding doc and the private-runbook. I'll mark the step as 'netops_wait'.

aj: ForgeGate netops replied — they allowed the two CIDRs and opened outbound 443. They said artifact sync will be retried at 13:40 PT.

meera: thanks. @carlos can you run the smoke once 13:45? If clean, we'll flip the canary to 10% and monitor the console.

carlos: yep. I'll run smoke at ~13:47 and post logs. If anything flakey, revert to 0% and we can fall back to hosted model.

sre-oncall: set a paged alarm on latency > 300ms for canary route and token spend > 20% of baseline. I'll create it now.

ops-bot: created alert: canary-latency-forgegate (threshold 300ms), canary-cost-forgegate (20%).

meera: final note — we still need signed GPG key exchange for their airgap appliance. @linh please coordinate offline with security to expedite.

linh: will do. filing short ticket to secops now. ticket: SEC-9876

meera: perfect. I'll update the customer-facing checklist after canary completes. will report back here with pass/fail.

aj: ForgeGate reports artifact sync succeeded at 13:44 PT. standing by for smoke.

carlos: smoke passed. health endpoints green, all canary traces look nominal. moving to 10% rollout now. :tada:

meera: awesome — thanks everyone. I'll leave this thread open for any fallout. If nothing by EOD, I'll close the handoff and add retrospec action items.

linh: noted, adding retrospective item: "streamline airgap artifact handshake + pre-signed bundle path".

sre-oncall: thumbs up. Closing comments: keep watch on cost spikes — this customer uses large batch requests.

meera: copy. closing in 24h unless someone flags issues.
